_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Flutter Model Test Report
summary: The Flutter Model Test Report provides a record of experimental flutter characteristics and model simulation accuracy used to investigate vehicle design and validate flutter analysis methods.
use_relationship:
The Flutter Model Test Report will be used to provide a record of experimental flutter characteristics and degree of accuracy as to model simulation of actual vehicles. The principal use is to investigate overall vehicle design characteristics as well as specific problem areas, particularly areas which do not lend easily to analysis. Also, test results when correlated with corresponding theoretical results validate the methods used in the actual air vehicle flutter analysis.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to any contract for which flutter model testing is required.
b. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
c. DI-MISC-81389A supersedes DI-MISC-81389.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revision, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Flutter Model Test Report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: This report shall contain, when applicable, results of the following:

children.title: Model design scale factors (or ratios) of the model parameters as compared to similar parameters of the full scale vehicle.
Photographs of representative models and of the model support.
Results of tests used to check that the model does simulate the air vehicle.
Mode and frequency of flutter encountered if flutter occurs.
Comparisons of test results with corresponding theoretical results.
Plots showing the wind tunnel characteristics and indicating the flutter boundary that must be attained (including the flutter margin).
Plots of flutter speed and frequency versus the variation in important parameters.
Plots of the damping coefficient, g, and the frequency versus velocity if transients are measured.
